# Vendor material (not committed)

This directory holds the Somnetics material this project was reverse-engineered
**from**. Everything here except this file is git-ignored: it is Somnetics
copyright, it is ~55 MB of .NET binaries, and none of it is needed to run the
toolchain. It is kept beside the code so a claim in [`PROTOCOL.md`](../PROTOCOL.md)
can be re-checked against its actual source rather than against memory.

## What belongs here

| Item | What it is | Where to get it again |
|---|---|---|
| `TranscendGo/` | The full Transcend GO ("MiniCPAP") desktop app, v1.1.2.0 — 58 payload files plus the ClickOnce manifest. **This is the decompile source for `PROTOCOL.md`.** | `https://transcend.minicpapsoftware.com/Somnetics.TranscendGo.Client.application` |
| `setup.exe` | The vendor's ClickOnce downloader stub. Pulls the same payload as the URL above. | mytranscend.com → software downloads |
| `MiniCPAP.appref-ms` | Windows ClickOnce launcher shortcut; just points at the URL above. | regenerated by `setup.exe` |
| `CDM-v2.12.36.4.U-WHQL-Certified.zip` | FTDI CDM driver bundle (the Micro's USB-serial bridge). Only needed on Windows; macOS and Linux drive both bridge chips natively. | ftdichip.com, or `Micro-Driver-Install-Instructions.pdf` in `docs/` |

The seven vendor PDFs live in [`../docs/`](../docs/) (also git-ignored) and are
distilled into [`../docs/NOTES.md`](../docs/NOTES.md), which cites them by
document number and page.

## Running the app

`TranscendGo/` is a Windows .NET Framework 4.x program. `TranscendGo/README - How
to Run.txt` (from the original download) has the vendor's own instructions; the
short version is to launch
`Application Files/Somnetics.TranscendGo.Client_1_1_2_0/Somnetics.TranscendGo.Client.exe`
with the folder structure intact.

**Caveat for this checkout:** the repo lives on WSL's ext4 filesystem, which
Windows reaches only over a `\\wsl$\...` UNC path. ClickOnce/.NET apps are
unreliable when launched that way. If it refuses to start, copy `TranscendGo/`
to a Windows-side folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\TranscendVendor\`) and run it from
there — nothing in this repo depends on the app running.

Windows may also mark the files as downloaded-from-internet and block them:
`Get-ChildItem -Recurse <path> | Unblock-File`.

## Why it is kept at all

The protocol in `PROTOCOL.md` — command framing, the 5-byte event format, all 28
event types, the calibration block — was derived from these binaries, not from
the manuals. The manuals confirm behaviour; the app defines the wire format. If a
protocol claim is ever disputed, this is the artifact to go back to.
